Descripción del puesto

Create 15-20 authentic short-form UGC videos per month for Stella, an AI-powered Spanish learning app by Novabeyond, with per-video or monthly retainer pay plus commissions.

Funciones principales

  • Produce 15 to 20 high-quality short-form UGC videos per month in Spanish.
  • Collaborate with the creative team following briefs and platform content strategies.
  • Showcase the Stella Spanish learning app authentically on camera.

Requisitos

  • Native Spanish speaker (strongly preferred).
  • Natural on-camera presence and storytelling skills.
  • Conversational English for smooth communication with the team.

Beneficios

  • Competitive per-video or monthly retainer pay ($100 to $2,000 USD/month) plus commissions.
  • Flexible 100% remote work with full creative guidance and unlimited product access.
  • Long-term collaboration opportunities across multiple apps.
